content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Scientific Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TMC ACTREC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TMC ACTREC Scientific Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How-To-Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by Tata Memorial Centre (TMC ACTREC) for hiring eligible candidates on an outsourced contract basis in research fields.

faq.question: Q2. What position is being offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites eligible candidates for the post of Scientific Assistant under advertisement number OS-A/CCE/018/2026 at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Scientific Assistant position under this recruitment drive conducted by TMC ACTREC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Scientific Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M. Tech / Biotechnology, M. Sc. Biotechnology, or M.Sc. in Life Sciences (Botany/ Zoology/ Biochemistry/ Applied Biology/ Microbiology), preferably with 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 35 years. Age relaxation may be considered and provided based on the candidate's relevant working experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Scientific Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly consolidated salary ranging between ₹. 28,450/- and ₹. 35,000/- p.m. as per the organization guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any online applications beforehand.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 13th October 2026 at the designated venue in Navi Mumbai.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Room No. 205, 2nd floor, CCE, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated CV along with original and self-attested copies of all educational certificates, experience certificates, and valid ID proofs.
